resources.string: Videos in a post\'s detail view, such as v.redd.it videos, start playing when the post opens. When off, the post shows its preview image with a play button, and the video loads when you tap it. GIFs are not affected.

GIFs, image links and Imgur albums are shown as images. Emotes show in the text either way. Tap an image to switch between full width and 200×200, double tap it to open it in full screen, where you can pinch to zoom.
Images in comments are shown at full width instead of up to 200×200. Images in posts always start at full width.
Long press an image to save it to Downloads/BaconReader.
On mobile data, images and video previews load when tapped.
Images and video previews load when tapped, on Wi-Fi and on mobile data.
Videos uploaded in comments and video links are played in the comment.
Bare YouTube links show the channel and video title.
A preview is shown under each YouTube link.
Bare X (Twitter) links show the post.
Bare Bluesky links show the post.
A still preview of post media and gallery images shows behind the progress bar until they load. Off: only the progress bar
All sites run JavaScript in the page of a link post, except the blocked ones. Off: only the allowed sites run it
Sites whose page in a link post never runs JavaScript, while JavaScript in link posts is on. One per line, subdomains included
Sites whose page in a link post runs JavaScript, while JavaScript in link posts is off. One per line, subdomains included
This RedGIFs video was not found
Android does not allow BaconReader to turn this on by itself. Tap \"Set up\", then select the Reddit links.\n\nThis can be done later in Android\'s settings: App info → Open by default.
Could not load the full template
No flairs found yet. Scroll the subreddit to load posts with flairs, then try again.
The author\'s avatar is shown before the name in comments, the reply screen and the inbox, as on Reddit\'s website
Normal is as tall as the text, Large as on Reddit\'s website. Needs Show user avatars
A faint disc behind avatars, as on Reddit\'s website. Needs Show user avatars
Comments when a post opens, from 200 to 500. Fewer load faster on slow connections
Loads the \"load more comments\" with up to this many replies right after the post\'s comments
Could not load Reddit chat. Check the connection and try again.
Chat messages apart from the inbox

Reddit also sends chat messages to the inbox, titled [direct chat room]. They\'re left out of the inbox, counted next to Chat in the menu, notified as chat messages, and marked as read when the chat opens. BaconReader\'s own message check finds them, when the app opens and at its update interval
Shows a circle next to each account in the menu, which picks a color for it, and the color of the account in use as a line under the toolbars
Lets you pick a color for each account in the menu, and shows the color of the account in use as a line under the toolbars.
Removes \"Log out\", which logs out of every account at once, from the menu\'s accounts.
Makes logging in to Reddit work again by using another Reddit app\'s client ID.
Adds a search button to the sort bar of posts, to find, highlight and jump between the comments with a text or user name, or show only those comments.
Shows images, GIFs, emotes, Imgur albums and videos in comments and posts, YouTube links with their title and thumbnail, and X and Bluesky links as the post.
Makes \"load more comments\" load the hidden comments again.
Hides spoilers that contain formatting, links or code, like other spoilers.
Adds options to load up to 500 comments when opening a post instead of about 200, and to load the \"load more comments\" with few replies automatically.
Shows tables in comments and posts as a grid, with wide tables that expand and scroll sideways.
Adds an option to show the author\'s avatar before the name in comments, as on Reddit\'s website, and always shows each account\'s avatar before its name in the drawer.
Adds a Patches entry at the end of BaconReader\'s settings, which opens the patches\' settings, and shows the patches\' version at the bottom of the menu.
Makes the text box of comments, replies, edits, messages and text posts as big as possible, with a bar of Reddit\'s formats and a character counter, and shows the formatting while typing.
Turns the orange inbox envelope back to normal when the last unread message is marked as read, and removes \"Mark unread\", which Reddit no longer supports.
Opens the comment reply screen, with the replied comment or message, when replying from the inbox, instead of the plain \"Send message\" form.

Adds Chat to the menu, next to the Inbox, which shows Reddit\'s chat from its mobile website on the main screen. The chat messages Reddit also sends to the inbox are counted next to Chat and notified as chat messages instead.
Opens Reddit\'s share links, and links to galleries, to videos, to posts without their subreddit and to posts on a user\'s profile, in the app instead of its browser.
Asks once to set up Reddit links to open in BaconReader, which Android doesn\'t let the app do by itself.
Fixes saving media to the device also creating an empty file.
Makes Imgur albums and galleries load again, and image uploads in comments and posts work.

Fixes empty thumbnails in the post list, shows a preview as thumbnail for link posts and crossposted galleries and as image in the card of galleries, and blurs the thumbnails of NSFW and spoiler posts.
Makes the meme templates of the drawing screen load again, with Imgflip\'s most used templates.

Shows a progress bar, the downloaded size and, by a setting, a still preview while post media and gallery images load, uses small previews for the thumbnails of galleries, shows a message instead of a broken page when a RedGIFs video was deleted, and adds settings for which link post pages run JavaScript.
Adds the sound to Reddit videos saved with \"Save to device\", which were saved without it.
Adds a setting to stop videos, such as v.redd.it videos, from loading and playing by themselves in a post\'s detail view: the post shows its preview image, and a tap on it plays the video.
Disables the \"Please take a few moments to provide feedback about BaconReader\" popup.
Disables the \"FINAL RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!\" popup that says goodbye when the app starts.
Shows the actual error when a Reddit request fails, instead of the message saying that BaconReader stopped working in July 2023.
Disables \"View Sidebar\" on Front Page, All, Popular, Friends and multireddits, which have no sidebar.
Keeps votes on a post in the post list when they\'re made while its comments load.
Fits each post of the Slide Show View to the screen, and lets a post\'s long text scroll in it.
Adds a Flair button to the sort bar of subreddits, to show only the posts with the chosen flairs.
Removes the award icons and the \"Give Award\" and \"View Award Details\" actions, which no longer work.
Removes Random and My Random, which no longer load, from the feed list.
Adds \"Select text\" to the menus of posts and comments, which shows their text in a dialog where any part of it can be selected and copied.
Shows the button that opens a text post\'s text in the post list as a page with a chevron, instead of a play button.
The client ID of an \"Installed app\" from https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps.
The redirect URI of that Reddit app. Empty keeps BaconReader\'s own, http://baconreader.com/auth.
The user agent of that Reddit app, ideally. Empty keeps BaconReader\'s own.
